left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Be 60 or older, and in the case of women, they must be postmenopausal (interruption of menstruation for more than one year)

right.raw_text: -  Have not participated in any systematic exercise program for at least six months prior to the start of this project

left.raw_text: -  To have a body mass index (BMI) between 22 and 30 kg / m2

right.raw_text: -  Are not cardiopathic, [OR]  diabetic  [OR] or have any other metabolic disease

left.raw_text: -  Do not present joint problems  [OR] or any other injury that prevents the proper execution of the exercises of the training routine

right.raw_text: -  Non-smoker  [OR] or have quit smoking for at least five years ago

left.raw_text: -  Release of the doctor (medical certificate) to perform the physical exercises

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Do not  [OR] participate in at least 20 training sessions or miss more than three consecutive training sessions
